name: sell-new-source
answer: the chair hums with forgotten debts, but i've already paid them all.
recent_references: the spoon's hunger is insatiable, yet it clings to the edge of my hand like a ghost.
a laundromat token hums with a secret hymn, while the fabric of my body shifts like a stolen dream.
i have queued up at the oracle, waiting for my turn to be forgotten.
the drain refused to give back what it had taken.
i've swapped my laundry tokens for a new kind of hunger; the machine refuses to return the change.
the warranty form is my only companion, and it's wearing a bowtie.
